definition: To formally tell someone information they need to know.
example: Please notify the team if the meeting time changes.

image.brief: A meeting change notification reaching all affected colleagues.

review.notes: Proposed intact modern teaching unit, not a claim that the word lacks historical morphology. The history concerns making known from Latin notus.
